core_obligations: Statement (lines 1335-1339): for every formula A, M^Sigma satisfies A at Delta iff A is in Delta.

Induction on A (proof lines 1341-1454): the propositional constant case reads V^Sigma(p) = {Delta : p in Delta} by definition; negation, conjunction, disjunction and implication each chain the semantic clause, the induction hypothesis, and the corresponding ccs-properties closure fact; the modal cases apply the canonical accessibility definition together with the Box/Diamond membership characterisations.
proof_roadmap: Connectives: semantic clause, induction hypothesis, ccs closure fact.
Modal cases: canonical accessibility plus membership characterisation.
